fact: On 31 July 2026 RASCOM's director general said the pan-African satellite organisation's services are already used in Côte d'Ivoire, citing the national broadcaster RTI's use of RASCOM satellite capacity during the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations.
Agence Ecofin reports that the Ivorian and Guinean ministers signed on 11 October 2024 a partnership agreement to interconnect the two countries' fibre optic networks.

Ministers Kalil Konate of Cote d'Ivoire and Rose Pola Pricemou of Guinea signed a protocol in Conakry on 11 October 2024 on interconnecting the two countries' fibre-optic networks, says the Ivorian government portal.
